pet_notes: Create one complete age-appropriate nonsexualized teenage human avatar with long copper-auburn human twin ponytails tied at fixed hair ties, center-parted bangs, lively dark eyes, rosy cheeks, visible human hands and cream ankle boots. Dress her in a modest cream-white sailor uniform with pale lemon piping, square collar, short yellow waist bands, compact pleated skirt, and one attached navy fabric rosette with an original abstract silver heart center. Twin-tails are ordinary human hair, never animal ears or tails. No animal anatomy, no logo, no text, no scenery, no shadows and no detached effects. Personality: bright group energy, playful, emotionally perceptive, expectant and hardworking; subtle nerves resolve into focused enjoyment and confident warmth.
